name: wuji22-float-p2
summary: Floating Wuji Hand 2.2 (glove variant; vendor impedance actuators) on the official 6-DoF floating wrist, no arm: HUG's wrist pose executed by protocol mano-1111-p1's evaluator with the MANO capsule hand replaced; fingers and the hand-root mount from rl/sim/multihand/retarget.HandRetargeter (registered for the Hand 2.2 by tools/float_wuji22/spec22.py) fitted on HUG's predicted landmarks; the vendor impedance actuators of EX337's model, the hand server's 3 rad/s ramp and the deployed over-close profile. New benchmark version (2026-11-21).

base.name: mano-1111-p1
base.note: scene, table plane, wrist trajectory (GraspPlanConfig defaults), lift and final-frame table-contact test are the base protocol's; handoff A2 as tools/float/collab_native.Harness.bench_handoff

source.port: tools/float_hands (sharpa-float-p1 / -p2, EX327), itself tools/ex210_1112/hbport210.py at commit db7ee7177 and the frozen October Wuji evaluator tools/float_wuji/wuji_eval.py
source.changes: tools/float_wuji22: the hand (an MJCF converted from EX337's pinned rrc / vendor URDF, hand only, 708.8 g), the retarget configuration (spec22.py), the scene's finger actuators and joint parameters (hand_eval22.build_scene), the command ramp and the close rule (hand_eval22.write_ctrl / Hand22.keyframes), the job pool (rollout22.py, tools/float_hands/rollout_hand.run_job unchanged)

retargeter.method: the table-arm pipeline's 4r retarget gate (tools/float_hands/fit4r.py): rl/sim/multihand/retarget.HandRetargeter.fit, root pose (6) and every actuator target solved jointly by least squares on the 21 MANO keypoint positions in the evaluator world (scipy least_squares, bounds = the compiled joint ranges, max_nfev 400, tolerances 1e-10); when its fingertip RMS error exceeds 10 mm, a refit from 5 starts (rotation offsets 0 and +-30 deg about the palm z and x axes) keeping the lowest cost; a final fingertip error above 10 mm = 'not retargetable', a failure not rolled out (stage invalid_input, not_retargetable = 1)
retargeter.palm_init_note: the fit's initial root orientation and orientation prior = the MANO wrist rotation times this matrix (the frozen Wuji evaluator's fixed MANO-wrist -> Wuji-palm rotation; the Hand 2.2's palm frame has the Wuji 1 palm axes: fingers +z, palm normal +x, thumb +y)
retargeter.open_pose: the fit of the official MANO start pose (flat hand, thumb base pre-bend 1.0 rad on x and y), root at identity with the palm init rotation
retargeter.closing_direction: HandRetargeter.closing_sign: +1 on every flexion joint of the Hand 2.2 (checked at construction: the deployed over-close adds +delta in joint coordinates)

wrist.note: the wrist carries the hand's weight (mano-1111-p2's rule): before every physics step the generalized gravity force of the whole hand subtree (rooted at the hand's root body) is written to qfrc_applied on the six wrist dofs; the fingers keep their gravity (tools/float_hands/hand_eval.HandWristLoad = tools/float/wristload.WristLoad with the hand's root)

finger_actuators.bias: -kp q - kv qdot, kv = Kt x 1.9115 x kd[S]
finger_actuators.force_limit: +-Kt x 1.5 A (the recipe's cap; the URDF's joint effort is not applied)
finger_actuators.ramp: the control moves toward the commanded target by at most 0.015 rad per 5 ms step (the hand server's 3 rad/s at 200 Hz)

physics.hand_joints: damping, frictionloss and armature per joint from the vendor recipe (wuji_hand2_actuators.yaml)

hand_contact.note: the frozen Wuji evaluator's mapping of the MANO capsule hand's contact values (as every floating protocol); the glove's softness and the pads' real friction are not modelled, so absolute rates are not predictions for the robot

physics.hand_model_edits: rl/sim/multihand/handspec_build.load_hand_spec with its hull-vertex cap undone (maxhullvert -1); vendor actuators of the MJCF deleted and re-added by the scene builder from the recipe at full precision; the vendor's 344 self-collision exclusions applied
physics.close_rule: lerp endpoint = fit backed off <= 0.2 rad toward the open pose on the flexion actuators of fingers 2-5 and on each thumb actuator; goal = fit + the deployed over-close profile (drive.deployed_overclose_rad, per joint, in the SDK's order); targets clipped to the ranges
physics.mount: T_wrist_root = T_world_wrist^-1 T_world_root of the fit, set per grasp as the root body's pos / quat inside the wrist body, with a fresh compile per grasp; the wrist plan moves the hand rigidly as MANO's wrist
physics.handoff_table_height: handoff A2 places the object on the compiled scene's table plane, as the frozen evaluator's harness
physics.object_contact: the object's collision geoms take the hand default solref 0.04 1 / solimp 0.5 0.95 0.001, as every floating protocol
physics.scene_mask: object and table geoms accept the hand's contype bits

labels.success_native: no contact between the table plane and any object geom at the final frame (t = 4.0 s, after the 0.5 m lift) and a valid simulation (finite state, no BADQACC warning during the rollout); as mano-1111-p1
labels.success_strict_v1: native success AND the final-frame hand-object contact includes the thumb (finger 1 of tools/float_wuji22/spec22: bodies ['r_thumb_']*) and at least one other finger AND final object rise >= 400 mm; the mano-1111-p1 definition with the fingers mapped by the spec's body prefixes; palm = ['r_mount', 'r_wrist', 'r_adductor_pollicis_cover', 'r_thenar_cover', 'r_midpalm_cover', 'r_hypothenar_cover', 'r_palm_index_cover', 'r_palm_middle_cover', 'r_palm_ring_cover'] and the wrist body
labels.october_rule: the evaluator's own flag (not on the ground at the final frame, no validity check); diagnostic only

digest_rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' ':') of {name, base_digest, hand_name, code, hand, retargeter{files}, drive} plus `wrist` {path, sha256, rule, parameters}

parameters.compensated_dofs: wrist_tx, wrist_ty, wrist_tz (slides) and wrist_rot (ball, 3 dofs)
parameters.force: F = J_com^T (M_hand * (-gravity)) with J_com = mj_jacSubtreeCom(mano_body_0) and M_hand = body_subtreemass[mano_body_0], recomputed and written to qfrc_applied on the wrist dofs before every mj_step of the official loop
parameters.fingers: no compensation: the finger joints' gravity load stays with the finger actuators
parameters.applies_to: every physics step of tools/float_wuji22/hand_eval22.rollout (approach, curl, settle, lift)
parameters.hand_root: the attached hand's root body (r_mount), instead of mano_body_0; the force, the joints and the step order are WristLoad's
